info.name: E-commerce & Inventory Backend - Phase 4 Verification v2
info.description: Updated from the user's Phase 1.12 collection. Covers current authentication, catalog, inventory, cart, orders, payment and movement workflows. IMPORTANT: some routes/request DTOs are provisional and explicitly marked VERIFY; compare them with current controllers before execution. Tests assert HTTP status only where response details are not yet confirmed. Successful ApiResponse responses are expected to use status/message/body/timestamp.

item.name: 01 - Authentication

request.description: Assumed route and payload based on the current project API design. Confirm AuthController mapping and RegisterRequest fields before running.

exec: const j=pm.response.json(); const b=(j.body!==undefined?j.body:j); const value=b.id; if(value!==undefined && value!==null) pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', value);

request.description: Assumed route and payload. Inspect the response to identify the exact JWT field; then save it to the token collection variable.

exec: const j=pm.response.json(); const b=j.body||j; const token=b.token||b.accessToken||b.jwt; if(token) pm.collectionVariables.set('token',token);

item.description: Verify exact request DTO field names and token response property against AuthController/AuthService.

item.name: 07 - Orders

request.description: Expected: 201 Created; order status PENDING; item snapshots and total are correct; physical quantity unchanged; reservedQuantity increases; cart is cleared; STOCK_RESERVED movement is recorded.

exec: const j=pm.response.json(); const b=(j.body!==undefined?j.body:j); const value=b.orderId; if(value!==undefined && value!==null) pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', value);

request.description: Expected: paginated result if the current service returns Page<OrderResponse>. Confirm actual JSON page structure.
Expected: only the authenticated customer's order is returned.

item.name: Admin search orders - VERIFY QUERY PARAMETERS

request.description: Confirm ADMIN role and supported filters (e.g. status) from OrderController.

item.description: Order placement and history routes are based on the current project context. Verify exact pagination and admin-search parameters.

item.name: 08 - Order lifecycle

request.description: Expected: valid PENDING order becomes CONFIRMED. No physical stock deduction at confirmation.

Prerequisite: order is CONFIRMED and payment succeeded. Expected: physical quantity and reservedQuantity both decrease by ordered quantity; status becomes FULFILLED; STOCK_FULFILLED movement is recorded.

item.description: Cancellation is intentionally not included as a runnable request because its exact controller route was not present in the uploaded collection or confirmed project context. Add it after checking OrderController.

item.name: 09 - Payments

request.description: Expected: payment outcome SUCCESS and a payment record. Payment must not deduct inventory; fulfillment does that. Confirm response status and DTO fields.
Use a separate eligible order. Expected: failed payment outcome; order must not be fulfillable.
Repeat the same request with the same key. Expected: no second payment operation. Compare response and database record count with the first request.

item.description: Payment endpoint, header and request body are based on the current project context. Confirm whether repeat-key behavior replays the original response or returns a conflict.

item.name: 10 - Inventory movement history

request.description: Expected: paginated movement records. Verify ADMIN access and actual page response shape.
Expected to include relevant ORDER movements, such as STOCK_RESERVED, STOCK_RELEASED or STOCK_FULFILLED, depending on the workflow.

item.description: Exact pagination parameters should be checked against InventoryMovementController.

item.name: 11 - Negative and authorization checks

request.description: Use this to establish whether product reads are public or protected. Expected status depends on SecurityConfig; do not assume 401.
Expected: 401 or 403 depending on the configured authentication entry point.

item.description: Use a non-admin token to test admin-only endpoints separately. Do not assume every endpoint's security rule; verify the configured policy.
